h: Seeing Yerushalayim Rebuilt Within the Present Exile

p: עֲנִיָּה סוֹעֲרָה לֹא נוּחָמָה (יְשַׁעְיָה נד, יא)
that the seven haftaros of consolation
correspond to the seven lower attributes;
corresponds to the attribute of Tiferes,
for Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for this attribute.
in the manner of what they said
כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר דַּל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן
"Wherever it says poor, afflicted and needy,
וְאָמַר מֵאַיִן יָבוֹא עֶזְרִי (תְּהִלִּים קכא, א)
and he said, "From where will my help come?" (Tehillim 121:1);
that he did not see in himself
שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ אֵיזֶה כֹּחַ בְּדִבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
that he had any strength in words of Torah;
"I lift my eyes to those who taught me and those who formed me"
which are his teachers and his fathers.
for this has no connection to his teachers.
Rather he said that although his teachers,
and likewise his fathers Avraham and Yitzchak,
he did not feel in himself
שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ אֵיזֶה כֹּחַ בְּדִבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
that he had any strength in words of Torah;
לֵית אֲנָא מוֹבִיד סִבְרִי מִן בָּרְיִי
"I do not abandon my hope in my Creator:
like his teachers and his fathers;
and likewise He also created the souls
וְכֵיוָן שֶׁבָּרָא הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ גַּם אוֹתִי
and since Hashem Yisbarach created me too,
לֵית אֲנָא מוֹבִיד סִבְרִי מִן בָּרְיִי
"I do not abandon my hope in my Creator."
all my life until this day";
for this was all his strength:
And this is the opening of this haftarah:
And they expounded in the Pesikta (on this haftarah):
That is, the preceding consolations were
that the main purpose of the exiles
is so that they merit to bring out
the aspect of the Oral Torah,
that is found among the nations.
And now more than eighteen hundred years
afflicted of words of Torah and of mitzvos;
so what do the consolations accomplish?
And this is why it said "not comforted."
And likewise it said there in the Pesikta:
"Storm-tossed — by the nations of the world."
That is, a stormy wind comes
And this is from the side of the north,
"Out of the north the evil shall break forth";
for the essence of evil is
and not enclosed by a wall.
And this is "storm-tossed" by the nations of the world,
"Remember, Hashem, against the children of Edom," etc.;
and one said, 'Clear it out, clear it out,'" etc.
On this the prophet came to console them,
"Behold, I will set your stones in fair colors,
and lay your foundations with sapphires."
וְאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רמ, א)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 240a):
וְעַל דָּא זַמִּין קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
"And therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined
to build the foundations of Yerushalayim
As it is written, 'and lay your foundations with sapphires,'" etc.,
"which have no weakness like the first ones.
בְּגִין דְּלֵית בְּהוּ נְהִירוּ עִלָּאָה וְכוּלֵּי
Because there is no supernal light in them," etc.;
that shine above and below," etc.
That is, the walls of Yerushalayim
were like the Clouds of Glory in the wilderness,
that any of Yisrael's enemies could enter;
and even Amalek, who was the scoundrel
"and smote the hindmost of you, all the weak at your rear";
כָּל מִי שֶׁהָיָה הֶעָנָן פֹּלְטוֹ וְכוּלֵּי
And so were the walls of Yerushalayim,
"The kings of the earth did not believe," etc.,
"that the adversary and the enemy would enter
"storm-tossed by the nations of the world," etc.,
And it said, to console them on this,
that He will make strong walls,
such that they will not be able to rule over them,
that they will not be able to break them;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (אֵיכָה ד, ז)
as they said in Midrash Rabbah (on Eichah 4:7, Eichah Rabbah 4:10),
about one who went to sell a sapphire, etc.:
and the sapphire stood in its place."

p: וְאָמַר אַחַר כָּךְ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ שָׁם
And afterward the holy Zohar says there (Zohar II 240b):
that those first foundations will be nullified
הָא כְּתִיב הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַרְבִּיץ וְגוֹמֵר
it is written, 'Behold, I will set,' etc.:
'I set' — to repair what was broken," etc.;
Rabbi Elazar said: It is a secret,
and this secret was given to the reapers of the field
those stones of the foundations of Tzion and Yerushalayim
the other nations ruled over them,
and they did not burn them, nor were they burned;
rather, all of them were hidden away," etc.
One must understand what is the secret
of which it said that it was given to know
only to the reapers of the field,
that the foundation stones were hidden away.
הֵם מַה שֶּׁאָמַר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַרְבִּיץ
is in its saying "Behold, I set,"
and did not say in the future tense, "I will set."
that even in the present Hashem Yisbarach
is setting, to repair what was broken;
וְרַק בְּרֶגַע קָטֹן עֲזַבְתִּיךְ (יְשַׁעְיָה נד, ז)
it was only "for a small moment I forsook you" (Yeshayahu 54:7),
and Hashem Yisbarach in the present
sets, to repair what was broken.
And it said, "I set your stones in fair colors"
that Yisrael placed in the wall;
for the walls of Yerushalayim were sanctified
that it should be the place that is before Hashem,
וְאָכַלְתָּ שָׁם לִפְנֵי ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְגוֹמֵר
"And you shall eat there before Hashem your God," etc.,
"that you may learn to fear," etc.
And the place of the Mikdash
עַל יְדֵי דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וּשְׁלֹמֹה
through David HaMelech, peace be upon him, and Shlomo.
וְזֶהוּ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַרְבִּיץ בַּפּוּךְ אֲבָנַיִךְ
And this is "Behold, I set your stones in fair colors":
in that you brought holiness into the wall,
And this is what it said afterward:
"and this secret was given to the reapers of the field
it is stated in the holy Zohar (beginning of the Idra Rabba):
"and the reapers of the field are few";
that is, in the Idra are the expositions of Atika,
and for this "reapers of the field" are needed:
those who know how to reap the field,
דְּאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קסו, ב)
for it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 166b):
הַאי אוֹר זְרַע לֵיהּ קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
"This light the Holy One, blessed be He, sowed
in the Garden of His delights," etc.
That is, the primordial light that was hidden away;
and since it was hidden away,
it is in the aspect of the intellect
that is hidden from all thought;
דְּמִטַּעַם זֶה נֶחְשָׁב מַאֲמַר יְהִי אוֹר
for this reason the utterance "Let there be light"
is counted in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 11b)
that is, after it was hidden away.
are those who reap the seeds from the field
of the Field of Holy Apples,
that the hidden should be revealed.
And when there is the revelation of Atika,
and all the foundations of Yerushalayim
are being repaired in their places,
דְּלָא שַׁלִּיטָא בְּהוּ שְׁאָר עַמִּין וְכוּלֵּי
for the other nations do not rule over them," etc.
when there is the revelation of Atika,
and especially at the second meal,
which is the meal of Atika;
therefore at this meal we say:
And therefore the consolations are read on Shabbos
the holiness of the aspect of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּתִּיקּוּנִים (תִּקּוּן יח, לד, א)
as is written in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 18, 34a).

p: וְאָמַר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַרְבִּיץ בַּפּוּךְ אֲבָנַיִךְ
And it says, "Behold, I set your stones in fair colors";
and it is stated in the holy Zohar (Pekudei there, Zohar II 240b):
'and she painted her eyes with kohl,'" etc.;
בַּר בְּזִמְנָא דְּיִכְחוֹל בַּר נָשׁ עֵינוֹי
"except at the time that a person paints his eyes
and fills his eyes with it;
and then he will see all the stones
and all the foundations of Yerushalayim
being repaired in their places," etc.
This is based on what is written
בַּתּוֹסֶפְתָּא (בָּבָא קַמָּא פֶּרֶק ט הֲלָכָה ט)
"and the 'daughters of the king' came out
that is, the kelipah called "bas melech,"
as they said in the Gemara (Shabbos 109a):
and before that it calls it "a free woman"
וּמַקְפֶּדֶת עַד שֶׁיִּרְחוֹץ יָדָיו ג׳ פְּעָמִים
"who is particular until he washes his hands three times."
וּמִן הַסְּתָם כֵּיוָן שֶׁמּוֹעִיל רְחִיצָה ג׳ פְּעָמִים
And presumably, since washing three times is effective,
it is a matter of impurity and kelipah;
and it said that kohl removes the bas melech
And this is what it said:
that one who paints his eyes with kohl
that Hashem Yisbarach constantly sets "your stones"
these are the stones that Yisrael founded in their holiness,
and no nation or tongue ruled over them;
only the walls were demolished and broken,
and the foundations were hidden away.
Hashem Yisbarach began to repair the breakage;
that is, Mashiach was born immediately,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה אֵיכָה א, נא וְעוֹד)
as is written (Midrash Rabbah, Eichah 1:51, and elsewhere).
"And I will make your pinnacles of kadkod" (Yeshayahu 54:12);
and as they said in the Pesikta,
that they showed Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi
and all of Lud shone with their light.
And this is "And I will make your pinnacles of kadkod":
that then the light of the moon
will be like the light of the sun (Yeshayahu 30:26);
for now the moon receives from the sun,
and then it will be like the light of the sun itself;
for the gates of Yerushalayim will then be
the righteous shall enter into it,"
and they will see eye to eye
that one who enters the gates of Yerushalayim
it is the gate of Hashem;
"And you shall eat there before Hashem your God,"
for one who ate in Yerushalayim
וְכָל שֶׁכֵּן מִי שֶׁנִּכְנַס לְשַׁעֲרֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ
and all the more so one who entered the gates of the Mikdash,
which was truly the gate of Hashem,
for there the Shechinah always rested.
And this is "and lay your foundations with sapphires,"
that is, that the wall was breached,
from which the stormy wind comes.
And on Shabbos, and especially at the second meal,
when there is the revelation of Atika,
one merits to see eye to eye
"Behold, I set your stones in fair colors"
that Hashem Yisbarach sets them in the present, constantly.
